name: bishop_blocked_by_own_pawns
description: The side to move has a bishop on the same color as its own pawns on that color's central squares, without the opponent having the same restriction.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'bishop_blocked_by_own_pawns'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a bishop on the same color as its own pawns on that color\'s central squares, without the opponent having the same restriction.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    CENTER_SQUARES = [chess.E4, chess.D4, chess.E5, chess.D5]

    def count_blocked_bishop_squares(color):
        count = 0
        for sq in board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, color):
            sq_color = (chess.square_file(sq) + chess.square_rank(sq)) % 2
            for cs in CENTER_SQUARES:
                if (chess.square_file(cs) + chess.square_rank(cs)) % 2 == sq_color:
                    if board.piece_at(cs) and board.piece_at(cs).piece_type == chess.PAWN and board.piece_at(cs).color == color:
                        count += 1
                        break
        return count

    stm_blocked = count_blocked_bishop_squares(stm)
    opp_blocked = count_blocked_bishop_squares(opp)
    return stm_blocked > opp_blocked
